name: investor-relations
title: Investor relations
purpose: How the venture raises money and keeps its investors and board informed (APQC PCF 12.1 and 12.3): one investor-relations/raises/<id>.json per fundraise, with its ask, materials, target investors, meetings and follow-ups, and one investor-relations/updates/<id>.json per investor or board update. The external-relationships function owns it, so only the external-relationships agent or a person writes these records. Never complete.
